label: first original token is x (t=0)
explanation: Fires exactly when the input at step 0 (the first original token) is the letter x, and nowhere else. Activation is constant (0.816) on every firing, so nothing modulates magnitude. Sequence length, later tokens and whether x repeats make no difference. It does not fire on x at any later original position, on x fed back as an input during the copy phase (including the copy-phase x that reproduces the first token), on the delimiter, or on any other token at t=0. Dev split: P=R=F1=1.0.
